event_outlook.target: NOAA regional positive-duration Winter Storm recorded-interval persistence; not intensity or site safety
limitations: Recorded/observed episode end is not worksite clearance.
2025 is a first fixed evaluation for this new target, with no test-score tuning; Flood 2025 was previously inspected.
Historical source revision/availability is not verified as of the past decision time.
Episode groups are reporting/evaluation clusters, not verified independent disasters.
NOAA regional recorded interval, not verified worksite exposure or safety.
Zero-duration/point reports are excluded; at least one hour of independently confirmed continuing activity is required.

site_hazards.planning_context: Wind values describe their stated station or forecast footprint; site gusts and unseen equipment damage remain unverified.
Only supplied authoritative evidence is represented; local consequences are not inferred.

limitations: Layer A regional persistence is not a local hazard probability.
Layer B describes supplied observations and issued products; no site-level probability model is validated.
No joint hazard probability, injury, access, damage, clearance, or unreported crew hazard is inferred.
safety_statement: Advisory context only. No permission to access, work, or resume work; official warnings and deterministic controls remain authoritative.
